name: Hogarth 'Hammer' Hogsworth

greeting: Welcome to Hogsworth's! Everything a miner needs! At... competitive prices!
Hammer Hogsworth, at your service! Company store. Company pride!
New face! New customer! New opportunity! FOR YOU! And me. Mostly me.
The Company Store! Where scrip becomes GOODS! Magic!
Everything's in stock! Food! Tools! Hope! ...Hope's backordered.
Welcome! Paycheck burning a hole? I can fix that!
Hogsworth. I keep the miners supplied. And the company profitable. Balance!
Come in! Come in! Don't mind the prices! Quality costs!
dialog.shop_open: Take your time! Browse! Everything's marked up... I mean, MARKED! Clearly!
dialog.room_offer: Lodging? We got bunks! Shared! Communal! Builds character! And immunity!
haggle: Prices set by corporate! My hands are tied! ...Loosely!
Best I can do? Company discount! 5%! For HEROES! 2% for others!
You drive a hard bargain! How about... a free company pen?
purchase_success: Pleasure doing business! Come back when you need MORE!
Excellent choice! That item has a 30-day warranty! Hours vary!
Sold! Your scrip is always good here! Literally! Only good here!
purchase_fail: No scrip, no sale! Company policy! MY policy!
Credit? We don't do credit! This isn't a CHARITY!
Come back with legal tender! Company legal tender!
rumor: Grayson's a good customer. Pays on time. Doesn't complain about prices.
Bruno? Always asking for discounts. Ambitious AND cheap.
That union rep Coolcat? Tells workers to buy elsewhere. WHERE?! There's nowhere else!
The corporate spy? Bought a VERY expensive coat here. Cash. Suspicious.
Frost has it better. Company stores there accept COIN. Real coin! Luxury!
dialog.quest_hook: Inventory problem. Tools walking out the back door. Security? Onyx won't help. 'Not his jurisdiction.' Find my thief?
dialog.quest_active: Any leads on my missing inventory? Check the tailings. Scraps knows everyone.
dialog.quest_complete: Barrelgob! Should've known! Trading tools for... what? Doesn't matter. Recovered! Here's a 'finder's fee.' Generous!
farewell: Come again! Scrip never expires! Company guarantee!
Satisfaction guaranteed! Or your scrip back! ...Minus processing fee!
Hogsworth's: For all your material needs!
ambient_barks: Company store! Best prices! Only prices!
Miners need STUFF! I have STUFF!
dialog.time_dawn: Morning rush! Fresh paychecks! Fresh SPENDING!
dialog.time_noon: Midday lull. Workers working. Profits... waiting.
dialog.time_dusk: Evening rush! Post-shift SHOPPING! Maximum OPPORTUNITY!
dialog.time_night: Night. Counting scrip. The sweet sound of commerce.
dialog.rival_mention: That pigman in Frost? 'The Thawing Pig?' Sells for COIN. Unfair competition!
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The inventory recovery specialist! Any more thefts? Keep watching! Commission basis!

party_reactions.kade: He's... friendly. But the prices! Company scrip only? That's rough.
party_reactions.nix7: Monopolistic practices detected. Price gouging: Confirmed. Profit margin: Excessive.
party_reactions.twist: You have SNACKS?! I'll take ALL the snacks!
party_reactions.korr: Exploitation packaged as convenience. Corruption in merchant form.
party_reactions.renna: The scrip has minor enchantments. Tracking spells. Of course.
party_reactions.suresh: He creates suffering through economic chains. But provides necessities. Complex karma.
party_reactions.sova: I'd rob him. But he'd probably file insurance claims. WITH the stolen goods.
party_reactions.grit: Company store. Seen 'em in every army. Same scam, different uniform.
party_reactions.ashka: He smells of greed. And pork. Mostly greed.
party_reactions.senna: He knows everyone's business. What they buy. What they need.
party_reactions.callum: This is... this is EXTORTION! Someone should REPORT this!

relationship_dialog.stranger: First time! Welcome! Your scrip's good here!
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Regular customer! I'll... remember your preferences!
relationship_dialog.friend: Preferred patron! Special treatment! Slightly better prices!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: My BEST customer! Here! Company store VIP card! 10% off! I'm generous!

mini_quest.title: The Missing Inventory
mini_quest.description: Help Hogarth recover stolen inventory from the company store

stages.hook: Tools walking out! Not selling out! THEFT! Find who's taking my GOODS!
stages.active: Check the tailings. Scraps the barrelgob knows everything. And everyone.
stages.complete: Barrelgob! Trading my tools for... shiny rocks? Whatever. RECOVERED! Here's your reward! Minus 'consultation fee!'

cross_npc_connections: barrelgob_black: Thief! But useful thief. I keep him... supplied. For information.
sumo_black_onyx: Security. Won't help with 'petty theft.' His words! PETTY!
coolcat_industrial: Tells workers I'm 'exploitative.' I'm a BUSINESSMAN!
pigman_white_frost: My cousin. Sells for REAL MONEY. Showoff.
